definitions.explanation: A household made up of a mother and her children with no father present, through divorce, death or never marrying. A common term in social policy and the news; the counterpart is {父子家庭|ふしかてい}, a single-father household.

examples.japanese: {母子家庭|ぼしかてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I grew up in a single-mother household.

examples.japanese: {母子家庭|ぼしかてい}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Support for single-mother households is needed.

examples.japanese: {母子家庭|ぼしかてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しく→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Many single-mother households struggle financially, and child poverty has become an issue.

notes:
⟦{母子|ぼし}→母子：20277_boshi⟧ (mother and child) + ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧ (household). In official usage the neutral umbrella term {ひとり親|ひとりおや}⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧ (single-parent household) is now often preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {母子家庭|ぼしかてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: to grow up in a single-mother household
- {母子家庭|ぼしかてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: support for single-mother families
- {母子家庭|ぼしかてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧: poverty among single-mother households

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {父子家庭|ふしかてい}: single-father household
- ⟦{片親|かたおや}→片親：27516_kataoya⟧: single parent; older and can sound negative
